verdict.rationale: The marketing site says it is "confident enough to let you compute your bill before you talk to us" and offers a one-to-one comparison against current managed ClickHouse spend, which points to a self-serve bill estimate. It also documents a free dev tier (up to 4 vCPU / 8 GB, no card) and a free cost audit. However, no actual pricing units, rates, or calculator details appear in the evidence, so a platform engineer cannot yet verify they could build a monthly estimate. Missing for 10: published per-unit compute/storage/egress rates, documented calculator inputs and outputs, pricing for BYOC vs managed tiers, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the estimate matches real bills.
